title: ca_issuers_http_uris returns Vec<String> that could be iterator
description:
In pkix-chain/src/aia_extract.rs:44-65, ca_issuers_http_uris allocates a Vec<String>, pushing owned URI strings into it. The sole consumer (build_with_aia at pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:650) immediately iterates the result.

What goes wrong: Each call allocates a Vec and N Strings for the AIA URIs. Since the consumer iterates once and discards, an iterator-based return would avoid the intermediate collection. In practice the number of caIssuers URIs per cert is 1-2, so this is a minor allocation savings - but it's a clean idiom improvement.

Location: pkix-chain/src/aia_extract.rs:44-65

Recommendation: Consider returning impl Iterator<Item = String> + '_ (borrowing from the parsed cert) or keeping the current shape given the small N and the tried_uris HashSet interaction in the caller.
